clue.text: White house, Italian style, in Morocco

definitions.text: White house, Italian style, in Morocco

parts.words: White house, Italian style, in Morocco
parts.note: the city's name means white house, and casa is the Italian (as well as Spanish) word for house, so the clue describes a Moroccan port by translating its name

explanation.surface: A whitewashed villa built in the Italian manner somewhere in North Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: The White House suggests Washington, but the clue is translating a place name: 'casa' is house in Italian and Spanish, and 'blanca' is Spanish for white.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest city of Morocco takes its name from the Spanish words for a white dwelling.

clue.text: Browbeaten officer got spliced

parts.note: CO is the usual abbreviation for commanding officer
spliced is slang for married, so got spliced means wed

explanation.surface: An officer, newly married, finds himself bullied by his bride.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone browbeaten has been intimidated into submission, which is what being cowed means.

clue.text: Filmed galley, resisting charge

parts.note: a scene that has been filmed has been shot
a galley is a printer's proof taken before page make-up

explanation.surface: A ship's kitchen caught on camera turns out to be bulletproof.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Galley' suggests a ship, but here it is a printer's term: a galley proof is the first trial print of typeset text.
explanation.definitionFit: A charge here is a load of shot or explosive, and anything able to withstand bullets is shotproof.

clue.text: Graduate starts to blossom and advance when extended

definitions.text: Graduate starts to blossom and advance when extended

parts.words: Graduate starts to blossom and advance when extended
parts.note: the opening letters of blossom and advance give the initials of a first degree, and extending those initials into full words spells out the degree's name

explanation.surface: A new graduate begins to flourish and get ahead once given more time.
explanation.walkthrough: BA is a graduate's degree; written out in full it becomes the three-word answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A holder of a first university degree in the humanities carries this title, abbreviated BA.

clue.text: Cases for deeds

explanation.definitionFit: Legal cases brought in court are actions, and deeds or acts performed are actions too.

clue.text: Instrument made from steel developed in California

indicators.note: in places the reworked letters inside the abbreviation

parts.note: CA is the postal abbreviation for California

indicators.note: developed suggests the letters of steel being worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A musical instrument forged from steel in a Californian workshop.
explanation.definitionFit: A celesta is a keyboard percussion instrument whose hammers strike metal plates, giving a bell-like sound.

clue.text: Notes about asteroid four hundred and thirty three

definitions.text: asteroid four hundred and thirty three

indicators.note: about means the two notes are turned round to read backwards

parts.note: soh is a note of the sol-fa scale, spelt SO in crosswords
re (ray) is another note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Musical notes written about a numbered space rock.
explanation.walkthrough: Asteroids are numbered in order of discovery; this one was among the first found to come near Earth.
explanation.definitionFit: Minor planet number 433, discovered in 1898, was named after the Greek god of love.

clue.text: Commit further offence, getting sap from tree

explanation.definitionFit: To sin again is to re-sin, and the sticky secretion of pines and firs is resin.

clue.text: Tabloid proprietor has duke in for a drink

indicators.note: in means the duke's letter is placed inside the newspaper owner

parts.note: The Sun is a British tabloid newspaper
a proprietor is an owner

explanation.surface: A newspaper baron invites a duke round for drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' is a link here; 'in' alone signals the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: A sundowner is an alcoholic drink taken at sunset, a colonial-era custom.

clue.text: Unrealistic hopes involving continental chessmen?

explanation.definitionFit: Daydreams that will never come true are castles in Spain, and the rooks of a Spanish chess set would be castles in that country.

clue.text: Relief work sir Henry reduced

parts.note: Sir Henry Wood was the English conductor who founded the Proms concerts
something reduced has been cut

explanation.surface: A charitable project being scaled back by a knight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relief work' suggests aid, but here it is printmaking in which the design stands out in relief.
explanation.definitionFit: A print made from a block carved so the image stands proud of the surface is a type of relief print.

clue.text: Yachtsman's problem over concealing current affair

indicators.note: concealing means the current's symbol is hidden inside the other letters
over tells us to turn the yachtsman's problem upside down, reading it from the end

parts.note: a sailor stuck with no sail cannot get anywhere
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A sailor's troubles hide a scandalous romance that is currently going on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns NO SAIL into LIASON, and 'concealing' tucks I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A liaison is a secret romantic or sexual relationship.

clue.text: Spider out in the rough like fly

indicators.note: in the rough means unfinished or roughed out, so the letters are given in a disordered state

explanation.surface: A spider loose in the long grass behaves like a fly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the rough' rearranges the letters of SPIDER OUT; it looks like a golf term.
explanation.definitionFit: Dipterous describes insects of the order Diptera, the two-winged true flies.

clue.text: Flog pass? It takes two to do it

definitions.text: It takes two to do it

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat or flog them
a pass at something, an attempt or turn, is a go

explanation.surface: Thrashing someone over a pass in a game, though it takes two to quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the saying 'it takes two to tango'.
explanation.definitionFit: A partner dance from Argentina, proverbially requiring two people.

clue.text: RAF officer receiving stolen picture

indicators.note: receiving means the officer's letters take in the slang for stolen

parts.note: PO stands for Pilot Officer, a rank in the Royal Air Force
stolen goods are slang hot

explanation.surface: An air force officer is caught handling a stolen painting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'receiving' doubles in the surface as the crime of handling stolen goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A snapshot taken with a camera is a photograph, a kind of picture.

clue.text: London theatre's guarantee of protection

explanation.definitionFit: The London Palladium is a famous West End variety theatre; a palladium is also a safeguard, after the statue of Pallas that protected Troy.

clue.text: Politician specifies details of crew

parts.note: to specify details is to state them
to crew a ship is to man it

explanation.surface: A politician spells out exactly who will be in the crew.
explanation.definitionFit: A statesman is an experienced and respected political leader.

clue.text: Idiosyncrasy in Italian art?

explanation.definitionFit: A personal quirk of behaviour is a mannerism, and Mannerism was the style of late Italian Renaissance painting.

clue.text: Remains of amphibian consumed by flames

indicators.note: consumed by means the amphibian is swallowed inside the other piece

parts.note: old flames are former lovers
an eft is a newt, a small amphibian

explanation.surface: The charred remains of a frog or newt burnt in a fire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flames' suggests fire, but here it means old flames, former sweethearts.
explanation.definitionFit: Remains are what is left over, as of a meal.

clue.text: English resort right to produce coarse grass

parts.note: a spa is a health resort

explanation.surface: An English seaside resort grows its own rough grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Esparto is a tough Spanish and North African grass used to make paper and rope.

clue.text: Act like twenty five, accepting rider's initial support

indicators.note: accepting means the rider's letter is taken inside the other piece

parts.note: the solution to 25 across is a person who incites, so acting like one means to agitate or provoke

indicators.note: initial picks out the opening letter of the rider

explanation.surface: Someone acting like a twenty-five-year-old needs a rider's help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twenty five' is the cross-reference to 25 across, INCITER; to act like one is to STIR UP, and 'accepting' takes in R.
explanation.definitionFit: A stirrup is the loop hanging from a saddle that supports a rider's foot.

clue.text: Sort of man taking meal daughter abandoned

indicators.note: abandoned means the daughter's letter is left out

parts.note: dinner is a meal

explanation.surface: A certain kind of man who eats his meal and walks out on his daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is from the phrase 'the inner man', meaning one's appetite or spiritual self.
explanation.definitionFit: The inner man is a person's inward nature, or jokingly their stomach.

clue.text: Leading character in local pharmacy

indicators.note: in means the letters lie inside the words local pharmacy

explanation.surface: The most important figure in the village chemist's shop.
explanation.definitionFit: Alpha is the first letter of the Greek alphabet, so it leads.

clue.text: Ornamental loop originally common in religious books

indicators.note: in places that opening letter inside the religious books

parts.note: PI is short for pious, meaning religious
OT is the Old Testament, a set of books of the Bible

indicators.note: originally picks out the opening letter of common

explanation.surface: A decorative loop first found in prayer books.
explanation.definitionFit: A picot is a small decorative loop on the edge of lace or ribbon.

clue.text: Officiator's extremely irksome way to divide media

definitions.note: officiator's here stands for officiator is, the definition being a person who officiates

indicators.note: to divide means these letters split the media word apart

parts.note: the press is the news media

indicators.note: extremely picks out the outermost letters of irksome

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A priest finds the press tiresome and tries to split them.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is Officiator with the 's standing for 'is'; the media are 'the press'.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who conducts religious rites officiates at a ceremony.

clue.text: Settled out east, being fully indulged

indicators.note: out means the letter for east is taken away

parts.note: someone settled in a chair is seated

explanation.surface: Settling down out east after enjoying every pleasure.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sated means having had one's appetite satisfied to the full.

clue.text: Trendy person quoting an instigator of action

parts.note: something trendy is in fashion, or in
one who quotes a source cites it, so is a citer

explanation.surface: A fashionable quoter of others stirs people into action.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who incites others provokes them into acting.

clue.text: Pragmatic type has to be relaxed about girl

indicators.note: about means the resting letters go round the girl's name

parts.note: to rest is to be relaxed
Ali is a girl's name, short for Alison

explanation.surface: A practical person must learn to unwind where his girlfriend is concerned.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who sees things as they are and acts sensibly is a practical, down-to-earth type.

clue.text: It's dull and lustreless — and that's gospel!

explanation.definitionFit: A matt finish has no shine, and Matt. is the abbreviation for the Gospel of St Matthew.

clue.text: After picking fruit, mother departs in angry mood

parts.note: hopping is the gathering of hops, the flowers of the hop plant used in brewing
ma is a familiar word for mother
D is the abbreviation for departs, as in railway timetables

explanation.surface: Mother storms off furious after a day of fruit picking.
explanation.walkthrough: Hop-picking was a traditional summer working holiday for Londoners in the Kent hop fields.
explanation.definitionFit: Being furious, extremely cross, is an idiomatic sense of the phrase.
